snippet.title: Nachtmahr Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve ancient puzzles, uncover lost memories, and collect fragments of a forgotten past as you awaken the poetic story hidden deep within the world. In Nachtmahr, every step reveals wonder—and every shadow, a whisper of something greater.
